name: Taira no Kiyomori
source: Taira no Kiyomori of this work is the builder of the Heike family. In the past, he fought with Yoshitsune and Yoritomo's father, Yoshitomo, in the Heiji rebellion, and realized the world of the Heike. Although he may look very old, he is a man with a resolute and dignified appearance that belies his age.
